_about: Keyword decisions for every extractor that conforms source keywords (src/main/lib/keywordConform.js). Keys are lowercase terms — a source spelling or the spelling a cluster lands on. folds: same concept → one term (spelling, acronym/expansion, typos, 'ABBR- Long Name' forms). drops: non-topics (prose fragments, boilerplate, publisher category labels, contentless words). splits: run-together terms. acronyms: casing for acronym tokens a title-casing normalizer would lower ('vmaf' → 'VMAF'). adds: vocabulary terms approved ahead of use. publisherFolds: folds that apply only to one publisher's keywords, for an acronym another publisher uses differently ('IAB' is the Internet Architecture Board in IETF keywords, the Immersive Audio Bitstream in media). Merged 2026-10 from the SMPTE canonical-audit passes (keywordVocabDecisions, keywordLongTailApply, keywordIdamsDecisions); context-specific folds stay on the docs they were applied to.
